title: Senior Systems Engineer (Electronics), EO/IR and Thermal Imaging
description:
**We are hiring: Senior Systems Engineer (Electronics), EO/IR and Thermal Imaging**

**Location:**
KINFRA Defence Park, Ottapalam, Palakkad, Kerala

**Employment:**
Full-time, on-site

**Experience:**
6+ years

**Compensation:**
₹12–18 lakh per annum fixed, based on experience and suitability, plus performance-linked variable pay. Higher compensation may be considered for an exceptional candidate with directly relevant experience.

About Ozak Technologies

Ozak Technologies is a DPIIT-recognised startup and licensed Indian defence company based at KINFRA Defence Park, Palakkad.

We design, integrate, qualify and support thermal imaging and EO/IR systems, including thermal weapon sights and surveillance systems, for defence and security users.

We are a small team. This is a hands-on role with direct responsibility for the product, reporting to the Managing Director.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on electronics engineer who can own the electronics of our products and take technical ownership of the complete system.

Our products bring together thermal camera cores, embedded processor boards, power electronics, displays and video interfaces inside rugged, battery-powered housings. You will be the person who understands how that electronics works, why a unit fails, and how to make the next build better.

**What you will do**

•    Take technical ownership of the electronics in our thermal imaging and EO/IR products: power, processing, video and display, interfaces and controls.

•    Carry out board-level debugging, fault-finding and repair on production and field-returned units, down to component level.

•    Bring up and integrate thermal camera cores, processor boards, displays and peripherals into complete, working products.

•    Design or modify interface, power and control boards, and take them through schematic, PCB layout, fabrication and assembly with vendors.

•    Write, modify and maintain embedded firmware for control, interfaces and power management.

•    Build test jigs and test setups, and write acceptance test procedures, assembly instructions and service procedures.

•    Support environmental, reliability and EMI/EMC testing, and fix what fails.

•    Investigate field failures, find the root cause and implement corrective actions.

•    Maintain BOMs, schematics, revisions and configuration records so every unit can be built and repaired the same way.

•    Evaluate electronics from suppliers and partners, and resolve component, quality and obsolescence issues with vendors.

•    Prepare systems for customer evaluations, demonstrations and field trials.

What we are looking for

**Must have**

•    B.E./B.Tech. or M.E./M.Tech. in Electronics, ECE, EEE, Instrumentation or a related discipline.

•    6+ years of hands-on electronics hardware experience in product development, integration, production or sustainment.

•    Strong board-level debugging with oscilloscope, logic analyser, bench supply and multimeter. Comfortable reading schematics and doing SMD rework.

•    Experience with microcontroller, SoC or FPGA based boards and common interfaces such as UART, SPI, I2C, USB and Ethernet.

•    Power electronics for battery-powered equipment: DC-DC converters, power budgets, battery charging and protection.

•    Practical schematic and PCB design experience in a tool such as Altium, OrCAD or KiCad, and experience working with PCB fabrication and assembly vendors.

•    Embedded C for board bring-up, control and test.

**Good to have**

•    Video and display interfaces: analog video, HDMI, MIPI or parallel camera interfaces, microdisplays.

•    Embedded Linux on SoM platforms.

•    Rugged or defence electronics, and testing to MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-810 or JSS 55555.

•    Thermal imaging, camera or EO/IR products. Not mandatory: we will train a strong electronics engineer on the imaging side.

•    Lithium battery packs and battery management systems.

•    Python or similar for test automation.

•    A working understanding of optics and mechanical integration. Deep optics expertise is not required for this role.

Relevant backgrounds include defence electronics, avionics and aerospace, space systems, rugged and industrial electronics, cameras and machine vision, medical devices, test and measurement, and automotive electronics.

The person we are looking for

Ownership matters as much as technical depth. We want someone who takes a fault or a product problem, understands it properly, fixes it, and documents it so it stays fixed.

You should be comfortable working in a small team without a large support structure, working directly on hardware, and learning the imaging and system side where you do not already know it.

Compensation and terms

•    Fixed compensation in the range of ₹12–18 lakh per annum, depending on experience and suitability.

•    Higher compensation may be considered for an exceptional candidate with strong, directly relevant experience.

•    Performance-linked variable component.

•    Long-term incentive opportunities may be considered for high performers, subject to company policy.

This is a full-time, on-site position at Ottapalam, Palakkad. Remote or hybrid work is not available for this role.

How to apply

Apply via LinkedIn or send your CV to hr@ozaktech.com with the subject "Senior Systems Engineer (Electronics)".

In your email, please include your notice period, current location, and a few lines on one electronics board or product you brought up, debugged or took to production, and what your part in it was. Candidates who can join at short notice will be preferred.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
**Description**
 Systems Engineer
   

  

**Full Location:** 
 Remote \- PH
   

  

 The Systems Engineer is responsible for the configuration, management, troubleshooting, and issue of resolution for critical business services across the globe.
   

  

 These services include Active Directory, Messaging applications, Intune/SW deployment and Endpoint Management tools, SSO, SharePoint, File Sharing, and Azure Virtual Desktop Global infrastructure administration. The engineer will also work with our Helpdesk, Application, and Dev\-Ops Teams, in order to provide end\-to\-end support for platform and application management services.
   

  

 We expect greater of ourselves... What’s Your Greater? Come find it at ResultsCX!
   

  

**In This Role You Will**
* Administration of Office 365 Services: E\-mail, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams
* Configure, deploy, and maintain Azure compute to include Azure virtual desktop services
* Azure Active Directory administration
* On\-prem and Remote endpoint Management via Intune, including SW deployment, patching/version management, and security policies
* Take part in technical project execution impacting these areas, in coordination with other teams and external vendors and customers
* Level 3 Escalation Support for outages and issues that cannot be resolved at lower levels
* Daily Monitoring and Alert Responses
* Assist and collaborate with other local and global IT teams as needed with Desktop/user support, local IT services, IDF/MDF, telephony, and connectivity


**We Are Looking For Someone Who Has**
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience with various Microsoft Cloud Platforms\- must include AVD, Azure AD, and Office 365 products and services
* In\-depth knowledge of Windows operating systems and experience with a wide variety of software applications.
* Strong experience with configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of DNS, DHCP SMTP\\Mail Relays, Microsoft Active Directory services including forest and domain design, policies, trusts, replication and topology; mail delivery including Active Sync, MX, DKIM, SPF and email security gateways
* Understanding High Availability, Proxies, Load Balancers, Firewall and Basic Networking Concepts.
* Strong Powershell Scripting, Software deployment, and endpoint management experience
* Strong Documentation and Communication Skills (Verbal/Written) in English
* Strong Problem Solving \& Troubleshooting Skills; independently and as a part of a team
* Strong Organizational Skills and the Ability to Manage a Diversified Workload.
* Exceptional Customer Service skills
* MCSA and/or MCSE certification preferred
* Any Additional Microsoft/Azure certifications a plus, or equivalent demonstrated experience


**About ResultsCX**
 ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.
   

  

 ResultsCX is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected factors under federal, state, or local law.
